advice.why: Coming to your work short on knowing the genre cost about 3.1 points off the whole a piece. That’s preparation, not training.

Tiring through the later moments of a piece cost about 0.7 points off the whole a piece. Stamina is your fitness, and Work Out, under Look After Yourself, builds it. Places to breathe in a piece leave less of it to drain, and on a night so does coming to the curtain rested. Rest restores energy, not fitness.
